name: POET Jewell (pits)
_regions: pixel polygons on the 704x576 frame, drawn from a real still on 2026-09-16: the line is the concrete apron in front of the pits; each pit is the bay under its sign. Trucks are placed by their wheels.

name: POET Jewell (probe lane)
_regions: 1920x1080, drawn 2026-09-16 from an empty lane: the line is the whole concrete lane from the far end down to the camera; the probe bay is the stretch under the sampling arm on the right. Rail cars beyond the lane are class 'train' and ignored anyway. Not yet checked against a frame with trucks in it.

name: POET Shell Rock
pin: Flint Hills Resources/Poet Shell Rock Ethanol
_regions: 720x650, drawn 2026-09-16 from a frame with one semi waiting and a pickup at the probe: the camera is far from the road, so trucks are ~30 px tall and the width floor is what tells a semi from a pickup. The line is the road east (right) of the probe where inbound trucks queue; the probe bay is the sampling station itself.

name: POET Gowrie (pits)
_regions: 3840x2160, drawn 2026-09-16 from an empty apron: three doors on the receiving building are the pits (wheels in the doorway or just in front of it); the line is the concrete apron below them. Not yet checked against a frame with trucks in it.

name: POET Gowrie (scale lane)
_regions: 3840x2160, drawn 2026-09-16 from an empty lane: the line is the inbound lane from the far end to the camera; the scale is the platform at bottom left. Trucks at the very far end are too small for the detector and are not counted. Checked 2026-09-17: a semi far up the lane counted correctly, but two employee cars parked on the grass median counted too, hence the exclusion box over the parking spots.

name: CHS Fairmont (soybeans)
_regions: 3840x2160, drawn 2026-09-17 from a frame with five trucks staged in the gravel lot: the line is that lot plus the inbound road along the right; the 'entrance' is the road right by the camera, where a truck is about to go into the plant. No pit is in view, so the pace comes from the entrance turning over, your own trucks, or the default. Soybeans only.

name: CHS Mankato (soybeans)
_regions: 3648x2052 fisheye, drawn 2026-09-17 from an empty lot: the line is the whole gravel staging lot; the entrance is the road at the far right where a truck heads into the plant. No pit in view. Checked the same morning: four employee cars parked along the office at the left counted as trucks in line, hence the exclusion strip. Soybeans only.

name: New Vision Hills
pin: New Vision Co-op Hills Terminal MN
_regions: Two 1280x720 snapshots from New Vision's cameras page, drawn 2026-09-17 from empty yards. S Yard (inbound): the gravel yard right of the employee parking. N Yard (dump pit): the yard in front of the receiving building, whose door is the pit.

name: New Vision Heron Lake
pin: New Vision Co-op Heron Lake MN
_regions: Two 1280x720 snapshots, drawn 2026-09-17 from empty lots. East Scale (inbound): the gravel in front of the scale, minus the corner where a forklift parks. West Scale (dump pit): the scale platform at left is the 'scale'; the lot beyond is line.

name: New Vision Miloma
_regions: Two 1280x720 snapshots, drawn 2026-09-17. Inbound Scale View: the gravel lane down to the scale platform at bottom right. Lot (dump pit): the receiving building's doors at the far end are the pit - trucks there are ~40 px tall - and the gravel lot in front is line.

name: New Vision Magnolia
_regions: 1280x720 snapshot, drawn 2026-09-17 with a tarped truck under the camera: the camera sits over the scale, so the truck filling the bottom of the frame is on the 'scale'; the line is the road curving in from the far end at right.

name: New Vision Brewster
_regions: 1024x576 snapshot through a window, drawn 2026-09-17 from an empty lot: the line is the gravel lot below the horizon. No pit in view.

name: New Vision Mountain Lake
pin: New Vision Co-op Mountain Lake MN
_regions: 1024x576 snapshot through a window, drawn 2026-09-17 with a hopper at the probe on the right: the probe stand is the 'probe'; the line is the gravel road from the far end down past the scale plate at bottom left.
